lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; posterior to the pectoral fin, at least four vertical columns are identifiable with 3-5 nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical lineaments of slightly higher pixel intensity that align with the vertical axes of the high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the superior flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance shift with highlights on the upper edge and a shadow gradient on the lower edge.
